text:
maya: Hey team — quick async check on INC-912 postmortem action items. I updated the spreadsheet (linked in the doc) and want owners to ACK and confirm due dates. TL;DR: three items, cross-team deps noted.

incident-bot: Incident INC-912 — postmortem created and assigned to maya. Rolling reminders enabled.

oliver: Ack. I'll own the kv-cache eviction fix — target ETA 2026-03-25 EOD. Blocking item: need QA infra testbeds + perf harness to validate. :eyes:

jen: I can provide testbeds. @oliver what exact config do you need (GPUs, dataset size)?

oliver: Need 2x T4 in staging or 1 A100 dev env, plus the synthetic perf harness and the small sample workload (1M tokens). If eng-infra can spin up resources by Mon morning I can finish by Fri.

sam: Eng-infra here — we can schedule 2 T4s in staging Mon morning. @jen please file a ticket with exact instance and network config so we can provision without back-and-forth.

jen: Done — INF-487 created with config and network notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-487

maya: Thanks. Next item: canary routing fallback + rollback plan doc. Owner currently Sam, due 2026-03-22. Sam — still good or prefer a different owner?

sam: I can take it, but need product to confirm the SLA thresholds we gate on. Pinged @ryan for the numbers.

ryan: PTL here — use these thresholds for canary gating: 95th percentile latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.1% per minute, and sustained token drop < 5% over 5m. Share these with Sam for the doc.

maya: Great — final open item: billing tag cleanup + alerting. Currently unowned in the tracker. This touches observability + finance. @jen would you be able to own this? Proposed due 2026-03-29.

jen: I can own the billing tag cleanup and alerts. Will coordinate with finance and observability leads. Proposed due 2026-03-29 works for me.

maya: To make things explicit, pasted a compact action list below. Please reply with :thumbsup: to confirm ownership or suggest an alternate owner.

```
- ACTION 1 | kv-cache eviction fix | Owner: Oliver | Due: 2026-03-25 | Blocker: INF-487 (eng-infra)
- ACTION 2 | canary routing rollback doc | Owner: Sam | Due: 2026-03-22 | Blocker: product thresholds (see Ryan)
- ACTION 3 | billing tag cleanup + alerts | Owner: Jen | Due: 2026-03-29 | Blocker: finance contact
```

oliver: :thumbsup: will start once INF-487 is provisioned.

jen: :thumbsup: I'll loop in finance and post the contact in the tracker.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft the rollback doc this afternoon and tag product for review.

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll update the postmortem tracker and add these items to the RCA. Calling out cross-team deps: eng-infra, product, finance. If any due date slips, please update the tracker and ping this thread.

incident-bot: Reminder set — 3 days before each due date. Will post a follow-up in thread when reminders fire.
